comments.text:
Feature: Azure Blob corpus source
  Scenario: Ingest items from Azure Blob storage
    Given a corpus configuration with a source kind of "azure-blob" and valid container and prefix settings
    When I run corpus ingestion
    Then Biblicus registers items with provenance URIs in the azure-blob scheme
    And retrieval evidence references those item identifiers
